errorCodes.meaning: The rotationId is unknown or its challenge has expired. Start a new rotate-challenge.
The old or new signature did not verify over the challenge, so control of both keys was not proven.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.

roleVac.description: Role credential re-issued to the new DID (opaque here): a Verifiable Authority Credential (`type` including `AuthorityCredential`) issued by the community with `issuerScope` `public`, whose `credentialSubject.authority` is `{ scope: <community DID>, actions: ["role:<name>"] }` — the shape vtc/vetting/vetters/grant/0.1 issues.

vmc.description: Membership credential re-issued to the new DID (opaque here).
